ActorFrame.InitCommand:
%function(self) DifficultyNames = { { {0.5,1.0,1.0}, ( THEME:GetMetric('Difficulties', 'Beginner') ) }, { {0.5,1.0,0.5}, ( THEME:GetMetric('Difficulties', 'Easy') ) }, { {1.0,1.0,0.5}, ( THEME:GetMetric('Difficulties', 'Medium') ) }, { {1.0,0.5,0.5}, ( THEME:GetMetric('Difficulties', 'Hard') ) }, { {0.5,0.5,1.0}, ( THEME:GetMetric('Difficulties', 'Expert') ) }, { {1.0,1.0,1.0}, ( THEME:GetMetric('Difficulties', 'EditShort') ) }, }
Jud_Normal = ThemeFile('Judge/'..THEME:GetCurLanguage() ) Jud_CPUPlr = ThemeFile('Judge/CPU/'..THEME:GetCurLanguage() ) end

Layer.OnCommand: %function(self) if GAMESTATE:IsHumanPlayer(PLAYER_1) then for i=1,table.getn(DifficultyNames) do if PlrDiff(PLAYER_1) == i then self:settext( DifficultyNames[i+1][2] ) self:diffuse( DifficultyNames[i+1][1][1],DifficultyNames[i+1][1][2],DifficultyNames[i+1][1][3],1 ) end end end end
%function(self) if GAMESTATE:IsHumanPlayer(PLAYER_1) then self:settext( GAMESTATE:GetCurrentSteps(PLAYER_1):GetMeter() ) end self:sleep(1) self:queuecommand('LoadJudgment') end
Layer.LoadJudgmentCommand:
%function(self)
-- This is to check for the language. if modJudgmentFont[1] == 1 and SCREENMAN:GetTopScreen():GetChild('PlayerP1') then local Plr = SCREENMAN:GetTopScreen():GetChild('PlayerP1') if Plr:GetChild('Judgment') then if GAMESTATE:IsHumanPlayer(PLAYER_1) then Plr:GetChild('Judgment'):GetChild(''):Load( Jud_Normal ) else Plr:GetChild('Judgment'):GetChild(''):Load( Jud_CPUPlr ) end end end
end

Layer.OnCommand: %function(self) if GAMESTATE:IsHumanPlayer(PLAYER_2) then for i=1,table.getn(DifficultyNames) do if PlrDiff(PLAYER_2) == i then self:settext( DifficultyNames[i+1][2] ) self:diffuse( DifficultyNames[i+1][1][1],DifficultyNames[i+1][1][2],DifficultyNames[i+1][1][3],1 ) end end end end
%function(self) if GAMESTATE:IsHumanPlayer(PLAYER_2) then self:settext( GAMESTATE:GetCurrentSteps(PLAYER_2):GetMeter() ) end self:sleep(1) self:queuecommand('LoadJudgment') end
Layer.LoadJudgmentCommand:
%function(self)
-- This is to check for the language. if modJudgmentFont[2] == 1 and SCREENMAN:GetTopScreen():GetChild('PlayerP2') then local Plr = SCREENMAN:GetTopScreen():GetChild('PlayerP2') if Plr:GetChild('Judgment') then if GAMESTATE:IsHumanPlayer(PLAYER_2) then Plr:GetChild('Judgment'):GetChild(''):Load( Jud_Normal ) else Plr:GetChild('Judgment'):GetChild(''):Load( Jud_CPUPlr ) end end end
end
